name: PaymentMethodCard
title: Templates/Platform/Account/PaymentMethodCard
summary: The Payment Method card of the Upgrade to Pro drawer: the card on file as one bordered row with the Visa plate, the last four digits and a Change action, which swaps the row for the card form until Cancel or Update. The drawer disables it while the upgrade is submitting. Built from `Card`, `FieldText`, `FieldSelect`, `Alert` and `Button`; the Visa plate is an inline card-brand mark, since webkit ships no card-brand asset.

variants.name: Editing
variants.summary: After Change: cardholder, country, number, expiry and security code over the PCI notice, with Cancel and Update stacked below sm.

variants.name: Disabled
variants.summary: While the upgrade submits, the Change action is disabled.
